verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI applies LLMs to crawled data. It offers LLM-driven structured extraction with any model, and the `crwl` CLI accepts natural-language questions (`-q "Extract all product prices"`). Adaptive crawling also judges when enough information has been gathered to answer a query. This is AI-powered extraction and Q&A over web content rather than generated insights or proactive suggestions about the user's own data. Missing for 10: proactive AI insights or recommendations, analysis of user-owned datasets beyond crawled pages, documentation of how query answers are produced, and independent hands-on corroboration.
